headline: China extends EV purchase tax exemption through 2027
headlineZh: 中国延长新能源汽车购置税减免至2027年
rawSnippet: The Ministry of Finance confirmed EV purchase tax exemption will continue, boosting domestic demand especially for mid-size SUVs.
rawSnippetZh: 财政部确认新能源汽车购置税减免延续，尤其提振中型 SUV 国内需求。

headline: Heatwave drives urban test-drive surge for compact EVs
headlineZh: 高温推动城市紧凑型纯电试驾激增
rawSnippet: Tier-1 cities report 12% more Spark Hatch test drives as competitors cut hatchback prices.
rawSnippetZh: 一线城市 Spark Hatch 试驾量增 12%，竞品 hatchback 降价施压。

headline: EU battery passport rules tighten for crossovers
headlineZh: 欧盟电池护照规则收紧，影响跨界车型
rawSnippet: New traceability requirements affect Ridge Cross export batches from Q4.
rawSnippetZh: 新追溯要求影响 Ridge Cross 四季度出口批次。
